description:
Do-Ha, an otaku who likes 2D better than people, coincidentally discovers Jae-Ik, a convenience store worker who looks exactly like his favorite Jake. And that night, a 3D Jake appears in Do-Ha's fantasy?! That he has to master the monster level to marry Jake?! After spending a passionate night with Jake, Do-Ha becomes addicted to the pleasure he has never felt before, and after that, perhaps because of Jake's curse, Do-Ha's body becomes horny all the time. But no matter how hard he tries on his own, his desires are not relieved, and in the end, Do-Ha shows up in front of Jae-Ik, who is working at the convenience store, with a toy stuck in his mouth... 

Will Do-Ha be able to fulfill his fantasy with Jake in reality?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
